experiment.title: Fix SIGINT exit code mapping in relay.js
experiment.hypothesis: The relay currently maps SIGTERM (15) to 128+15=143. It must map SIGINT (signal name 'SIGINT') to 128+2=130.
experiment.falsifier: If the probe still fails with exit code 143 after this edit, the hypothesis is false and the environment or signal handling logic differs from assumed.
experiment.intendedBenefit: Preserves correct shell exit codes (SIGINT→130, SIGTERM→143) as per contract.
